verdicts.reason: Both have the same structural problems. The #FLATTENTHECURVE bar has shrunk to a thin strip with tiny text that is hard to read. The symptom list has re-wrapped into run-on lines ('Shortness of breath Dry cough', 'Sore throat Headache'), so it no longer reads as six items. The list is also jammed against the top edge, the sparkle is blown up into a competing focal point, and the doctor's body is cut off flat at the bottom. B is slightly worse: its headline 'SYMPTOMS' is bigger and almost touches the doctor illustration, and its list sits even tighter to the top. A keeps a clear gap between the headline and the figure.
